title: Violencia y poder
goal: Read about the mechanisms behind the conquest beyond swords and horses: a massacre used to intimidate, a legal document nobody understood, and how fast indigenous armies adapted.

items: Explain how the Cholula massacre was justified, and what recent historians suggest instead.
Explain what the Requerimiento was and how it was actually used.
Explain why some historians think Spanish military superiority is exaggerated.
Describe what power in the conquest actually depended on.
Use 'puesto que / ya que', 'en cuanto a' and 'por consiguiente' in formal historical argument.
